envVars.name: SIMMER_API_KEY
envVars.description: Your Simmer SDK API key (from agent registration).

envVars.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Polygon EVM private key. The standard self-custody signer.

envVars.name: OWS_WALLET
envVars.description: OWS wallet name. Optional key store — set instead of WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY if the key lives in an OWS vault.
